einzeiler: Lindsey Clancy mistrial, severe holiday storms, and college sports eligibility battles.
kurzfassung: A judge declared a mistrial in the high-profile Lindsey Clancy murder case after the jury deadlocked on charges related to her children. Meanwhile, severe holiday weekend storms caused widespread damage from the Midwest to the East Coast alongside soaring gas prices. In other news, college football faced a major eligibility dispute after a court cleared former professional players to join LSU.
stichpunkte: A Massachusetts judge declared a mistrial in the Lindsey Clancy case after jurors failed to reach a unanimous verdict over postpartum psychosis arguments.
Severe holiday weekend storms brought torrential rain, powerful winds, and rare tornadoes to regions from the Midwest to the mid-Atlantic.
Drivers faced record-high gas and diesel prices, with regular fuel averaging over $4 per gallon ahead of Labor Day.
President Trump dismissed the conflict with Iran as small potatoes during a press briefing following the deaths of 18 American service members.
Nepalese rescue teams pulled two men alive from a blocked hydropower plant tunnel nine days after a devastating glacier-triggered flash flood.
A Louisiana judge issued an injunction allowing former professional players to compete for LSU, prompting an immediate legal challenge from the SEC.
Pennsylvania police arrested a mother and son in connection with the fatal stabbing of a college freshman whose body was found in her Jeep.
Over 100 volunteers in Pennsylvania relocated a massive 6,700-pound 9/11 memorial sculpture to make it accessible to the public ahead of the 25th anniversary.

clips.hook: Jury deadlocked on postpartum psychosis defense
clips.text: The jury remained unable to determine whether the mother acted intentionally or suffered from severe mental illness during the tragedy, resulting in a mistrial.

clips.hook: Passenger restrained with duct tape after mid-air disturbance
clips.text: An airline flight was forced to divert after a traveler became extremely disruptive, prompting fellow passengers to intervene and physically secure him.

clips.hook: President Trump dismisses Iran conflict as small potatoes
clips.text: The commander-in-chief downplayed an ongoing military engagement that claimed nearly two dozen American lives, leading to immediate political backlash.

clips.hook: SEC fights back against player eligibility ruling
clips.text: The athletic conference filed a federal lawsuit against a university to block former professional athletes from returning to collegiate competition.

clips.hook: Moving a 6,700-pound 9/11 memorial to a public park
clips.text: Scores of volunteers utilized heavy machinery to transport a massive commemorative monument out of a secure facility so the broader community could view it.

beschreibung:
Aaron Katersky reports on the stunning twists in the Lindsay Clancy case with the judge declaring a mistrial after jurors deliberated for seven days and remained deadlocked – and the defense attorney's last-ditch effort to avoid a mistrial; Pierre Thomas has the shocking new images of a plane passenger duct-taped to a seat with his hands tied, after a confrontation in mid-air, with the airline accusing him of being unruly; Lama Hasan has details on the miracle in the mud after two men were rescued from a tunnel filled with debris, nine days after catastrophic flooding ravaged Nepal; and more on tonight’s broadcast of World News Tonight with David Muir.
